title: Stripe subscriptions
summary: Monthly or yearly plans paid through Stripe Checkout, with a billing page and Stripe's own billing settings.
description: Adds plans (each linked to a Stripe price) and subscriptions. A Plans and billing page lets people pick a plan and pay on Stripe's secure checkout. Stripe then tells the app what happened through a signed webhook (checkout completed, invoice paid or failed, subscription changed or cancelled), and only the server marks a subscription active. Manage billing opens Stripe's customer portal to change card, switch plan or cancel. Rules stop anyone marking their own subscription paid. Staff manage plans and see every subscriber.

params.name: subscriber_role
params.label: Who subscribes
params.description: The role whose people buy a plan (their own table is the subscriber).

notes: A Stripe account with a recurring price for each plan (paste each price id into the plan).
A Stripe webhook endpoint at the URL get_contract lists for stripe-subscription-events (Backend, API in the builder), with its signing secret in STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

includes: Tables plan and subscription (two starter plans)
BillingPanel component on a Plans and billing page
A Stripe-signed webhook that applies checkout, invoice and subscription events
Server functions: checkout, billing settings and a manual check with Stripe
A staff page for plans and subscribers
highlights: Stripe's signed webhook confirms every payment on the server
Rules: nobody can mark their own subscription active
The Stripe key never reaches the browser
No app address to configure: return links use the app's own URL
